Role Title: Professional Shopper

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Professional Shoppers to contribute expert insights and analyses for a high-impact customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Through detailed product research, comparison, and evaluation, you'll play a key part in developing data-driven AI solutions that reflect authentic consumer trends and decision-making logic.

Scope of Work

  1. Conduct comprehensive product research across a wide range of categories, pinpointing key attributes and differentiators.
  2. Perform detailed price comparisons to identify patterns, market trends, and the best consumer value propositions.
  3. Supply actionable consumer insights based on evolving market preferences, user reviews, and firsthand experience.
  4. Evaluate and compare competing products, summarizing strengths, weaknesses, and distinctive features.
  5. Provide feedback on AI-generated outputs, ensuring accuracy and alignment with authentic product data.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated expertise in shopping, product research, and comparative analysis across diverse product types.
  2. Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize data and draw actionable conclusions.
  3. Experience leveraging market research methodologies and consumer insight tools.
  4. Proven ability to articulate detailed findings effectively in both written and verbal formats.
  5. Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, online marketplaces, and product review ecosystems.
  6. Meticulous attention to detail and a passion for uncovering new consumer trends.
  7. Previous participation in research, consulting, or expert contributor opportunities is a plus.
